timecoda: Compositional Data Analysis for Time-Use Behaviour Research

Source: R/timecoda-package.R
timecoda-package.Rd

Tools for compositional data analysis (CoDA) of time-use behaviour, such as the 24-hour composition of sleep, sedentary behaviour, light physical activity and moderate-to-vigorous physical activity. A composition is declared once and then modelled as a predictor of an outcome. It enters each model through its isometric log-ratio (ILR) coordinates, computed with 'robCompositions'. The models include linear, generalized linear, Cox proportional hazards, ordinal, multinomial and robust linear models, with multilevel (mixed) variants. The package estimates the effect of reallocating time between behaviours (compositional isotemporal substitution) and plots compositions and reallocations. Predictions and reallocation contrasts, with their confidence intervals, come from 'emmeans'.
